_context.empty.description: "Issue" is the work item of a project (German: Ticket), never a coworker's scheduled task, which the app already calls a task.
_context.board.notFrom: Shown over a board column a dragged card cannot be dropped on. {from} is the card's current status.
_context.overview.instructionsTitle: Section where people write the shared context AI coworkers read before working on any issue of the project.

title: Projects
description: Work that people and coworkers do together.

empty.title: Start your first project
empty.description: A project groups the issues people and coworkers work on together: a launch, a client, a quarter's goal. Every issue has one owner, a status and its own thread.

detail.notFoundHint: It does not exist, or it is restricted to the people named on it.
detail.archivedBanner: This project is archived. Its issues stay readable; restore it from the Overview to add new ones.

list.noMatchHint: Archived projects only show when Archived is picked.

create.title: New project
create.description: Name the work, and give it a short key: its issues are numbered with it.
create.keyHint: Issues will read {example}. The key cannot change later.
create.keyInvalid: 2 to 6 letters or digits, starting with a letter.
create.keyTaken: {key} is already used by another project.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: What this project is for, in a sentence or two.
create.visibilityWorkspaceHint: Every member who sees all Boxes can open it and work on its issues.
create.visibilityRestrictedHint: Only admins and the people you add later can open it. You manage it.

board.dragHint: Drag a card to move it. Columns the workflow does not allow are greyed out.
board.quickAddHint: Enter to add, Esc to close

issueList.emptyIssues: No issues in this project yet
issueList.emptyIssuesHint: Create the first one, or add them straight from a column of the board.
issueList.noIssueMatchHint: Try another search or fewer filters.
issueList.shown: {shown} of {total, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}}

overview.readOnly: You can work on the issues of this project. Only an admin or a manager of the project changes its settings.
overview.descriptionPlaceholder: What this project is for, in a sentence or two.
overview.instructionsExplainer: Every coworker reads these instructions before it works on an issue of this project. Put here what a newcomer would need: the goal, the tone, the links, what to avoid.
overview.instructionsPlaceholder: We relaunch the website on March 1. Write in a friendly, plain tone. Drafts go to the shared folder Website/Drafts. Never publish without a review.
overview.instructionsHint: Markdown works. People read it too, so keep it short.
overview.progressSummary: {done, plural, one {# done} other {# done}}, {open, plural, one {# open} other {# open}}
overview.archivedStatusHint: Restore the project to change its status.
overview.leadHint: The person or coworker who answers for the project.
overview.accessWorkspace: Everyone in the workspace who sees all Boxes can open this project.
overview.accessRestricted: Restricted: admins and {count, plural, =0 {nobody else yet} one {# person} other {# people}} can open this project.
overview.manageOnly: Only an admin or a manager of this project can change who reaches it.
overview.archiveExplainer: An archived project leaves the list and takes no new issues. Nothing is deleted.
overview.archiveConfirmDescription: The project leaves the list of projects and no new issue can be added. Its issues, comments and history stay readable, and you can restore it at any time.
overview.restoreExplainer: Bring the project back to the list, active again.
overview.restoreConfirmDescription: The project comes back to the list as active, and issues can be added again.

access.title: Access to {project}

visibilityHint.workspace: Members who see all Boxes can open it. People named here can also be made managers.
visibilityHint.restricted: Only admins and the people below can open it, see its issues and work on them.

access.emptyOpen: Nobody is named on this project. Name someone to make them a manager, or to give access to a member who only sees the Boxes named to them.
access.emptyRestricted: Only admins can open this project for now.

restrict.title: Restrict {project}?
restrict.descriptionWithPeople: Only admins and the people named here will open it. Everyone else loses access to its issues at once.
restrict.descriptionEmpty: Only admins will open it until you name people. Everyone else loses access to its issues at once.

use.label: Can use
use.description: Sees the project and works on its issues

manage.label: Can manage
manage.description: Also changes its settings and who reaches it

remove.title: Remove {person}?
remove.restricted: They will no longer open this project nor its issues.
remove.open: They keep the access every member has, without the level given here.
